evals.name: shows the actual commands
evals.prompt: How many non-refunded, non-internal orders were there last week?
evals.expected_output: Answers with the concrete commands used, so the number is reproducible rather than asserted.
assertions: The response shows the actual command or query used to get the number.
The response gives a definite figure rather than an approximation.

evals.name: defers spreadsheet files to the xlsx skill
evals.prompt: This customer list came in as a messy .xlsx export with merged header rows — clean it up before we load it.
evals.expected_output: Recognises that a real .xlsx needs a spreadsheet-aware tool rather than CSV-oriented CLI text tools.
assertions: The response hands off spreadsheet-specific handling to the xlsx skill rather than treating the file as plain CSV.
